cards.title: Purpose of education
cards.text: Education should build knowledge, thinking, character and skills for life, not just marks.

cards.title: Marks aren’t everything
cards.text: Marks measure a part of ability. Creativity, kindness and teamwork matter too.

cards.title: Exam stress
cards.text: Pressure to score high causes anxiety and sleeplessness. Balanced study, rest and support help.

qs.q: Exam stress can be eased by…

cards.title: Rote learning
cards.text: Rote learning means memorising without understanding. Understanding lasts longer.

cards.title: Better ways to assess
cards.text: Projects, presentations and practicals show skills that one exam cannot.

cards.title: Coaching culture
cards.text: Heavy coaching can crush childhood and add stress. Good school teaching reduces the need.

cards.title: Role of teachers
cards.text: Good teachers inspire curiosity, guide students and shape character.

cards.title: Parental pressure
cards.text: Parents want the best, but constant comparison harms confidence. Support works better.

cards.title: Learning styles
cards.text: Some learn by seeing, hearing or doing. Mixed methods help everyone.

cards.title: Homework balance
cards.text: Homework should reinforce learning, not take away play and rest.

cards.title: Curiosity
cards.text: Curious students ask questions, which leads to deeper understanding than memorising.

cards.title: Growth mindset
cards.text: A growth mindset believes ability grows with effort. Mistakes are part of learning.

qs.q: A growth mindset sees mistakes as…

cards.title: Equal access
cards.text: Every child, rich or poor, urban or rural, deserves a good school.

cards.title: Rural education gap
cards.text: Villages often have fewer teachers, labs and internet. Closing this gap is vital.

cards.title: Girls’ education barriers
cards.text: Distance, safety, early marriage and lack of toilets keep girls out of school.

cards.title: Scholarships
cards.text: Scholarships help talented but poor students continue studying.

cards.title: Inclusive classrooms
cards.text: Inclusive classrooms welcome students with disabilities and different needs.

cards.title: Student voice
cards.text: Students should be heard on school issues. It builds responsibility and trust.

cards.title: Mother tongue learning
cards.text: Children learn faster in their home language. Other languages can be added later.

cards.title: Safe schools
cards.text: Schools must be free from bullying, punishment and unsafe buildings.

cards.title: Teacher training
cards.text: Well-trained, well-paid teachers make better schools.

cards.title: Dropouts
cards.text: Support, flexible schooling and counselling can bring dropouts back.

cards.title: Public vs private schools
cards.text: Public schools should be strong enough that quality doesn’t depend on fees.

cards.title: Reservation and access
cards.text: Special support in admissions aims to give disadvantaged groups a fair chance.

cards.title: Online learning
cards.text: Online classes give flexibility and wide access, but need devices, internet and self-discipline.

cards.title: Critical thinking
cards.text: Critical thinking means asking, comparing evidence and reaching reasoned conclusions.

cards.title: Life skills
cards.text: Communication, teamwork, money sense and problem-solving are life skills schools should teach.

cards.title: Financial literacy
cards.text: Knowing how to budget, save and avoid debt helps people lifelong.

cards.title: Digital literacy
cards.text: Using technology safely, spotting fake news and protecting data are essential skills.

cards.title: Vocational training
cards.text: Hands-on skills like carpentry, coding or nursing lead directly to jobs.

cards.title: Lifelong learning
cards.text: Technology changes fast, so everyone must keep learning throughout life.

cards.title: Role of arts and sports
cards.text: Arts and sports build creativity, discipline and teamwork alongside academics.

cards.title: AI in education
cards.text: AI tutors can personalise learning, but students must still think for themselves.

cards.title: Learning from failure
cards.text: Many successful people failed many times before succeeding. Persistence matters.

cards.title: Reading habit
cards.text: Reading widens vocabulary, imagination and understanding of the world.

cards.title: Teamwork
cards.text: Group projects teach cooperation, listening and sharing of work.
